projects.name: Numira
projects.title: Numira — Accounting & Business Management
projects.subtitle: Numira — Accounting & Business Management
projects.shortDescription: Designing clearer workflows for accounting and business management, making complex financial tasks easier to understand and navigate.
projects.detailedDescription:
I designed key areas of Numira, including customer and supplier management, purchasing, accounting, and settings. My work covered purchase orders, bills, payments, vouchers, fiscal-year closing, user roles, and security flows.

The focus was on organizing information-heavy screens, maintaining consistent interaction patterns, and making important financial actions clear and predictable.

projects.name: SOMTU
projects.title: SOMTU — School of Management, Tribhuvan University
projects.subtitle: SOMTU — School of Management, Tribhuvan University
projects.shortDescription: A complete responsive university website designed to make academic information, resources, and registration easier to access.
projects.detailedDescription:
I designed the SOMTU website across desktop and mobile, creating 87 screens and 81 component variants.

The project included academic programs, notices, events, research, resources, and a seven-step registration process. I also developed a comprehensive design reference to support consistency and developer handoff.

projects.name: The Vedic Sewa
projects.title: The Vedic Sewa — Spiritual Services Platform
projects.subtitle: The Vedic Sewa — Spiritual Services Platform
projects.shortDescription: Designing a connected platform that simplifies spiritual service bookings and interactions between customers and gurus.
projects.detailedDescription:
I designed customer and guru experiences for puja, yatra, and consultation bookings across web and mobile.

The work included user profiles, booking management, a shop and purchase flow, refunds, livestreams, notifications, and verification processes. Special attention was given to status-based actions, clear navigation, and handling empty, pending, locked, and error states.

about.heading: About
about.mainDescription:
Hi, I'm Yogendra Chaudhary, a UI/UX and Product Designer who enjoys simplifying complex digital experiences.

I started my professional design journey at Aarawan Media & Tech, where I completed a three-month UI/UX internship and was appointed Junior UI/UX Designer.

I work on user flows, interface design, reusable components, and interaction patterns, with a focus on usability and consistency. I enjoy collaborating with developers, refining designs through feedback, and turning ideas into practical digital products.

designProcess.heading: Design Process
designProcess.intro: My design process focuses on understanding the problem before shaping the interface. I work through user flows, design systems, interaction details, and continuous refinement to create products that are both useful and consistent.

steps.title: Systems Thinking
steps.description: I break down complex workflows into clear, connected experiences, ensuring that information, actions, and interface states work together logically.

steps.title: User Research
steps.description: I use usability testing, interface reviews, and feedback to identify friction, understand user needs, and improve the overall experience.

steps.title: Interaction Design
steps.description: I design user flows and interface interactions that make navigation intuitive, actions predictable, and everyday tasks easier to complete.

steps.title: Cross-functional Collaboration
steps.description: I collaborate with developers to communicate design decisions, maintain consistency, and support the accurate implementation of digital products.
